client.business_model: Multi-site outpatient medication-assisted treatment provider for opioid and alcohol use disorders
client.client_history: Founded in 2010, SaVida Health delivers medication-assisted treatment, counseling and case management for substance-use disorders. Council Capital acquired a controlling interest in 2017, after which the company expanded from New England into multiple Mid-Atlantic and Southern states.

locations.source: SaVida Health press release on savidahealth.com (Sep 2024) stating the company "operates over 50 clinics"
locations.notes: Official press release gives the most recent count ('over 50 clinics'). Earlier 2020 article (bhbusiness.com, Nov 2020) cited 22 locations, supporting growth trajectory.

employees.source: bouncewatch.com company profile (accessed 2024-09) listing 155 employees; SignalHire range 100-200 employees corroborates
employees.notes: No employee count published by the company. Bouncewatch provides a specific figure, which aligns with the broader range reported by SignalHire.
